description:
Folded into fz-k22.26 before implementation because the direct registry split and lazy native-boundary derivation cannot be verified green separately.

Retained discovery
NativeProgram.callable_boundaries must begin from actual BackendCallableEntry publications only. BackendDirectCallableEntry is lookup authority; a direct-only boundary is minted only at a concrete FunctionRef/Lambda materialization fallback. Native's current eager boundary inventory creates phantom boundary: None records and loses published boundary association.

Signal
After the direct/public split, full cargo test --lib shows direct-only enum reducers and typed captures incorrectly present in native boundary inventory, while a published reducer loses its boundary target.

Closure condition
Close as folded when fz-k22.26 lands the complete direct authority split with lazy direct-boundary derivation and full gates pass.
title: Derive native direct boundaries at concrete closure producers
